trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ سُبْحَانَكَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ تُعْبَدُ بِتَوْفِيْقِكَ وَتُجْحَدُ بِخِذْلَانِكَ اَرَيْتَ عِبَرَكَ وَظَهَرَتْ غِيَرُكَ وَبَقِيَتْ آثَارُ الْمَاضِيْنَ عِظَةً لِلْبَاقِيْنَ وَالشَّهَوَاتُ غَالِبَةٌ وَاللَّذَّاتُ مُجَاذِبَةٌ نَعْتَرِضُ اَمْرَكَ وَنَهْيَكَ بِسُوْٓءِ الْاِخْتِيَارِ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA SUBHAANA-KA LAA ILAAHA ILLAA TO’BADO BE-TAUFEE-QEKA WA TUJ-HADO BE-KHIZ-LAANE-KA ARAIY-TA E’BARAKA WA ZAHA-RAT GHEYA-ROKA WA BAQEYAT AASAA-RUL MAA ZEENA A’ZA-TAN LIL-BAAQEE-NA WASH-SHAHA-WAATO GHAALE-BATOON WAL-LAZZAA-TO MOJAAZE-BATOON NA’TARE-ZO AMRA-KA WA NAH-YAKA BE-SOOO-IL IKH-TEYAA-RE.

trans.en: O my God! There is no God but You: glory be to You. You are Worshipped by Your success You are denied for Your letting down, You have shown us the lessons, and Your changes have become apparent The remains of the past are left for those who remain to learn from. Lusts are powerful and carnal desires are attractive We use our bad free will to challenge Your Decrees and Prohibitions.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: وَنَمِيْلُ عَنِ الرَّشَادِ وَنُنَافِرُ طُرُقَ السَّدَادِ فَلَوْ (فَاِنْ) عَجَّلْتَ لَا اِنْتَقَمْتَ (لَانْتَقَمْتَ‌) وَمَا ظَلَمْتَ وَلَكِنَّكَ تُمْهِلُ عَوْدًا عَلٰى يَدِكَ (بَدْئِكَ) بِالْاِحْسَانِ وَتُنْظِرُ تَعَمُّدًا لِلرَّافَةِ وَالْاِمْتِنَانِ فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَمَكَّنْتَهٗ اَنْ يَتُوْبَ كُفْرَ الْحُوْبِ۔

lines.rarabic: WA NAMEELO A’NIR RA-SHAADE WA NONAA-FERO TORO-QAS SA-DAADE FA-LAW (FA-IN) A’J-JALTA LAA INTA-QAMTA (LAN TAQAM-TA) WA MAA ZALAM-TA WA LAKIN-NAKA TUMHE-LO A’W-DAN A’LAA YADE-KA (BAD-E-KA) BIL EH-SAANE WA TUN-ZERO TA-A’MMO-DAN LIRRAA-FATE WAL-IMTE-NAANE FAKAM MIMMAN AN-A’M-TA A’LAIY-HE WA MAKKAN-TAHU AN YATOO-BA KUFRAL HOOBE.

trans.en: We are blind towards good insight and have deviated from the Right Path, and evaded ways of righteousness Thus if You rush and take revenge, it would not be oppression However, You give us more time with Your Continued Kindness and wait to perfect Your Kindness and Grace How many people did You bestow Your Blessings upon and granted an opportunity to repent from the great sin?

arabic.text: وَاَرْشَدْتَهُ الطَّرِيْقَ بَعْدَ اَنْ تَوَغَّلَ فِي الْمَضِيْقِ فَكَانَ ضَالًّا لَوْ لَا هِدَايَتُكَ وَكَانَ طَائِحًا حَتّٰى تَخَلَّصَتْهُ دَلَائِلُكَ وَكَمْ مِمَّنْ وَسَّعْتَ لَهٗ فَطَغٰى وَرَاخَيْتَ لَهٗ فَاسْتَشْرٰى فَاَخَذْتَهٗ اَخْذَةَ الْاِنْتِقَامِ وَجَذَذْتَهٗ جُذَاذَ الصِّرَامِ۔

lines.rarabic: WA ARSHAD-TAHUT TAREEQA BA’DA AN TA-WAGH-GHALA FIL MAZEE-QE FA-KAANA ZAALLAN LAW LAA HIDAAYATO-KA WA KAANA TAA-E-HAN HATTAA TA-KHALLA-SATHO DALAA-E-LOKA WA KAM MIMMAN WAS-SA’TA LAHU FATA-GHAA WA RAA-KHAIY-TA LAHU FAS-TASH-RAA FA-A-KHAZ-TAHU AKH-ZATAL INTE-QAAME WA JAZAZ-TAHU JO-ZAAZAS SERAA-ME.

trans.en: How many people did You direct to the Right Path after they were stuck in a bad situation? They would have been lost if You had not guided them, but it was Your clear reasons that saved them How many people did You bestow Your Blessings upon but they rebelled, and gave them more time, but they became stubborn, so You took revenge and destroyed them.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ مِمَّنْ رَضِيْتَ عَمَلَهٗ وَغَفَرْتُ زَلَلهُ وَرَحِمْتَ غَفْلَتَهٗ وَاَخَذْتَ اِلٰى طَاعَتِكَ نَاصِيَتَهٗ وَجَعَلْتَ اِلٰى جَنَّتِكَ اَوْبَتَهٗ وَاِلٰى جِوَارِكَ رَجْعَتَهٗ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهٖ وَسَلَّمَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA FAJ-A’L-NEE FEE HAAZE-HIL LAIY-LATE MIMMAN RAZEE-TA A’MA-LAHU WA GHAFAR-TO ZALLAL-LAAHO WA RAHEMATE GHAF-LATAHU WA A-KHAZ-TA ILAA TAA-A’TE-KA NAASE-YATA-HU WA JA-A’L-TA ILAA JANNATE-KA AW-BATA-HU WA ILAA JAWAARE-KA RAJ-A’TA-JU WA SALLAL-LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HI WA SALLAMA YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA.

trans.en: O my God! Please establish me amongst those from whose deeds You are pleased on this night whose slippages You Forgive, and whose negligence You have Mercy upon, and whom You grab and lead towards obeying You and have placed his return near You in Paradise Please bestow blessings on the Prophet Muhammad and his Progeny and peace O the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
